name_input: LAXMI PUMPS PVT LTD; LAXMI PUMPS PVT LTD
export_evidence: No export shipment row found. The only customs rows retrieved are inbound to India. Exact row: "2026-01-19 | LAXMI PUMPS PRIVATE LIMITED | RADER-VOGEL | PARTS OF INDUSTRIAL PALLET WHEEL ... | SAHAR AIR CARGO ACC INBOM4, India | HAMBURG FUHLSBUETT, GERMANY | 84312090 | 8859606" — origin Germany, destination India, i.e. an IMPORT, not an export. Source: importkey.com/countries/india/laxmi-pumps-private-limited, page counter states "Total Shipments 22 Records detected"; only 5 rows were actually visible in the free view (counter 22 vs 5 rows seen). No bill of lading with an Indian origin port and foreign destination was observed.
domestic_evidence: No GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tender award or contract record was retrieved. web_search returned no results (searx connection refused), and volza/eximpedia/trademo free views returned HTTP 403. Domestic supply activity therefore cannot be confirmed or denied from public sources within this check.
note: Actual customs activity IS documented, but in the import direction only: 5 visible rows dated 2025-11-05 to 2026-02-24, all India-bound from Germany (Hamburg / Hamburg-Fuhlsbuettel), ports Nhava Sheva Sea INNSA1 and Sahar Air Cargo INBOM4, counterparties Rader-und Rollenfabrik GmbH & Co. KG and Rader-Vogel. HS codes actually seen: 84312090 (parts of industrial pallet wheels — matches the declared 843120 family), 73251000 (other cast articles of non-malleable cast iron) and 86090000 (returnable galvanised-steel IBC containers). So the declared HS 843120 is consistent with observed records; no HS correction needed. The company appears to be a German-linked casting/pallet-wheel component operation importing into India, not an exporter. No export shipments found — 'следов экспортных поставок не найдено'. Domestic Indian supply evidence: not found in accessible sources, recorded as unknown rather than confirmed. Revenue and export volume: null — not public in the sources consulted, not estimated.
